name: CPU-Driven Task Spawning
definition: A model where the CPU decides when and how GPU tasks are launched, treating the GPU as a coprocessor that executes work requests originating from the CPU but cannot generate new work requests on its own.
summary: CPU-Driven Task Spawning centralizes rendering control on the CPU, which decides GPU work while the GPU executes passively, differing from GPU-driven models by treating the GPU as a passive executor.
